# Fix My AI Rank

> Fix My AI Rank helps B2B companies get cited in AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude) through entity signal audits, schema markup fixes, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

Fix My AI Rank is built and operated by TangySlice Collective, a B2B marketing agency. The site offers a free, automated AI visibility report for companies that rank well on Google but are missing from AI-generated answers.

## Report

- [AI Visibility Report](https://fixmyairank.com/): Free report benchmarking a company's entity signals, content gaps, and schema markup against its top competitors.
- [AI Visibility Platform](https://fixmyairank.com/ai-visibility-platform/): How a free, specific report compares with subscription AI visibility monitoring platforms.

## Glossary

- [What Is AI Visibility?](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/ai-visibility/): Definition and why it matters.
- [What Is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/answer-engine-optimization/): AEO definition, what an answer engine is, and how AEO differs from SEO and GEO.
- [What Are Entity Signals? (And What Is an Entity in GEO?)](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/entity-signals/): Definitions, the signals that matter, and how to measure them.
- [What Is Google AI Overviews?](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/google-ai-overviews/): GEO guide for brands.
- [What Is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)?](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/retrieval-augmented-generation/)
- [Schema Markup Checklist for AI Visibility](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/schema-markup/): Organization, WebSite, FAQPage, Article, Product, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD with examples.
- [What Is Share of AI Voice?](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/share-of-ai-voice/): The GEO metric explained.
- [What Is an AI Citation?](https://fixmyairank.com/glossary/what-is-an-ai-citation/): GEO definition and examples.
